decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk fits the premium office business and the post-2020 demand for flexible workspaces, so performance likely meets aspiration and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
A chair family is a core, broadly usable range that supports both contract and residential sales, and an established premium maker's slack allows it to keep carrying such a product.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain volume and a higher chance of falling short of aspiration, but low carrying costs and links to the rug collection make keeping it more likely than not.
The soft upholstered sofa by a renowned design studio was prominently promoted in 2019 and sits in the firm's core upholstery competence, so it is likely meeting expectations.
A high standing table complements the office and meeting portfolio at low cost, though its weaker standalone importance makes it a modest candidate for pruning.
The rug collection extends the firm's interior offering and was presented on its own page in both archived years, and slack allows it to be kept while its results remain uncertain.
